yt_title: Drop files in, get fields out 📄✨ #Shorts
yt_description:
Still reading every resume, invoice and brief yourself? Let AI do the reading, right inside your Stackby tables.

Add documents to an attachment field and an AI field reads each one. It returns the type, the key fields (name, total, due date, goal…) and a one-line summary. Use your own API key from Anthropic (Claude), OpenAI (ChatGPT) or Google (Gemini), billed to your own account.

Works for
• Resumes: experience, skills, fit
• Invoices: vendor, total, due date
• Content briefs: goal, deadline, summary
• Contracts: term, renewal, notice period

👉 Try document AI free: https://stackby.com/signup

• Resume Screening
